fund_name: Clean Energy Transition Partnership Joint Call 2025
host: Clean Energy Transition Partnership under Horizon Europe
summary: The Clean Energy Transition Partnership (CETP) 2025 Call is a transnational funding opportunity supporting research, development, and innovation projects promoting the energy transition towards climate neutrality by 2050. The call focuses on seven Transition Initiatives (TRIs) covering integrated net-zero energy systems, zero-emission power technologies, storage and renewable fuels, heating and cooling solutions, regional and industrial energy systems, and integration in the built environment. It targets large-scale international consortia and aims to advance clean energy technologies and system solutions across Europe and partner countries.
reporting_requirements: Financial and audit reports according to Horizon Europe regulations
Adherence to open access and data management plans as per funding terms
